newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banespa deal may be near.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banespa deal may be near.

text.p: Brasilia was rife with speculation Wednesday that the government may have finalized details of a solution for troubled Sao Paulo state bank Banespa after a "final" meeting between state and federal officials.

Sao Paulo state finance secretary Yoshiaki Nakano said after talks with Finance Ministry executive secretary Pedro Parente he "hoped it was the final meeting." Finance Ministry officials declined to comment, but the local media quoted Parente as saying before his meeting with Nakano that he foresaw Banespa being taken over by the federal government.
